notes: Allowed values only. The client rejects anything outside these lists, so a caller picks from options instead of inventing parameters.
The size menu is exactly these 12 canvases; auto is intentionally not offered as a size. Omit --size only when the provider default is explicitly wanted.
Menu labels follow the product UI: 2048x... is 2K; 2560x... and 3840x... are 4K.
source=observed means the value came from a real response; source=documented means it follows the GPT Image compatible contract and has not been individually confirmed against this relay.
size_reliability values: observed = some canvases confirmed on this relay; documented = contract only; ignored = observed to ignore the size parameter; fixed = one native canvas.
verified lists the values this relay has actually delivered at the requested canvas; the client still reports sizes and warns when the delivered canvas differs.
Probed on 2026-10-24 with gpt-image-2: 2048x2048 came back exactly, while 3840x2160 came back as 3838x2160, so treat the largest sizes as approximate.
Edit this file to add a model or correct a limit; no code change is needed.
